text:
Finn is immediately before Cara, and the chain Gus < Ben < Dev < Ivo has gaps of at least 3 between Gus, Ben and Dev. I tried the earliest option first, with Gus in slot 1.

1. Cara must be exactly two slots from Gus, so Cara is in slot 3 and Finn in slot 2.
2. Try Ben in slot 4. Then Dev is in slot 7 or 8.
3. If Dev were in slot 7, Ann would need to be in slot 4 or earlier, but none of those slots is free. So Dev is in slot 8 and Ivo in slot 9.
4. Ann must be at least 3 slots from Dev, so Ann is in slot 5 or earlier. Slot 5 is the only free one.
5. Hana must be at least 3 slots from Ben, so she is in slot 7 or later. Elif must come after Cara, so Elif takes slot 6 and Hana slot 7.

I checked every constraint against this schedule and all hold. I didn't test the other placements of Gus, Ben and Dev, so I haven't shown this is the only solution.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Gus","2":"Finn","3":"Cara","4":"Ben","5":"Ann","6":"Elif","7":"Hana","8":"Dev","9":"Ivo"}
CONFIDENCE: 97
